content: GOAL: propose one hyperbolic SID-table quality metric correlated with Stage-3 Recall@10, computed only from the exported SID table + optional frozen Issue #126 behaviour reference + training split, no val/test, no tuning, under 1 min on 24587 items. CHECK: re-read the contract and the measured leaderboard (Q_H +0.634/0.738; HBAA +0.701/0.762; all partition-geometry metrics fail; path likelihood fails because it rewards collapsed 2/3/12-code tables). OBSERVED: the only working family uses the frozen reference as a source->target CONTRAST on training pairs; HBAA uses a history Karcher barycentre vs a MEAN of ten negatives. Still open: pick a construction that uses BOTH the whole-history barycentre AND the full negative distribution, is collapse-safe by construction, and differs from hyp_cell_expected_rank / HBAA. NEXT: inspect the local task directory for concrete file/array names so INPUTS is exact.

FINAL: hyp_history_fullneg_rank_excess. Query = Karcher barycentre (unit-curvature Poincare ball) of the user's whole TRAINING history source points; candidates = Karcher barycentres of level-1 SID buckets' target points; score = temperatured soft expected rank of the positive bucket over ALL C-1 other buckets (full negative distribution, no mean-of-10); M = mean_u(e_null - e_obs) in [-1,1], higher better, with a deterministic size-matched CRC32 label-permutation null and user-fold cross-fitting. Collapse/one-code -> 0, random -> 0, perfect -> +0.5. Uses only SID table + frozen Issue126 reference (s,t,c_ref,tau_ref) + training split; no val/test, no tuning. Differs from HBAA (ten-negative mean + inner-product Delta) and hyp_cell_expected_rank (single-anchor query, no null). Full formatted block printed in the response.
